bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, holding above the Apr 9 low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 超卖，守在 4月9日低点上方

read.en: SanDisk rose 3.6% on Nov 6 to $835.06, fading from a $912.09 high (low $816.42) on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($976.1), 10-day ($1,132.7), 30-day ($1,398.2) and 100-day ($1,559.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,272.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,310.52), and RSI is 26, oversold.
read.zh: 闪迪 11月6日上涨 3.6%，收于 $835.06，自盘中高点 $912.09 回落（低点 $816.42），成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$976.1）、10 日（$1,132.7）、30 日（$1,398.2）和 100 日均线（$1,559.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,272.2）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$1,310.52），RSI 为 26，处于超卖区。

read.en: No level changed: the rebound stalled under the $851.6–855 Apr 9 close and high, and the $816.42 low held above $804–805. Resistance is $851.6–855, then $912–947 (Nov 6 high, Apr 23–24 lows) and $980–1,014. Support is $804–816 (Nov 5, Apr 9 and Nov 6 lows), then $758.2 (Apr 8 low) and $680–692. A close above $855 would target $912–947; below $804, $758.

s.en: Nov 6 low $816.42; Nov 5 low $803.97; Apr 9 low $805
